methods.label: Bisect the base and use Pythagoras
methods.explanation: The altitude, median, and vertex-angle bisector coincide, so \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\). Thus, \(BD=5\) and \(AD=\sqrt{13^2-5^2}=12\).
methods.levelReason: The isosceles altitude property and Pythagorean theorem are Grade 8 knowledge; midpoint calculation and square roots are earlier prerequisites.
